record.what_it_does: Twenty is an open-source CRM (self-hostable or cloud) for managing companies, people, and opportunities, with a schema-per-tenant REST and GraphQL API that auto-generates endpoints for custom objects.
record.auth_notes: API keys (used as static Bearer tokens, created in Settings → API & Webhooks) give full workspace-level access and are meant for internal scripts. OAuth2 (authorization code + PKCE, dynamic client registration per RFC 7591, plus a client-credentials grant for server-to-server) is what Twenty documents for external apps acting on behalf of a user — the fit for a multi-user agent toolkit. Scopes are limited to `api` and `profile`.
record.access_notes: Twenty is open source (self-hostable via Docker for free, with full API/webhook/OAuth access and no approval step). Cloud also offers a 30-day free trial with no credit card, after which paid plans ($9+/user/month) apply. A developer can get working API credentials immediately either by self-hosting or via the cloud trial.

evidence.quote: Twenty implements OAuth 2.0 with authorization code + PKCE for user-facing apps and client credentials for server-to-server access
Create an API key in Settings → API & Webhooks → + Create key
Sign up for Cloud in under a minute and start your 30-day trial
Is Twenty really open-source? Yes... You can self-host to fully own your infrastructure
Both are available as REST and GraphQL. GraphQL adds batch upserts and the ability to traverse relations in a single query.
Every Cloud workspace ships with a native MCP server. Connect your AI assistant via OAuth and it can read and write your CRM data in natural language.
Twenty sends an HTTP POST to your URL whenever a record is created, updated, or deleted.

record.open_questions: The OpenAPI spec is generated dynamically per workspace (no single static published spec file) — retrieved via authenticated endpoints rather than a fixed public URL, so exact endpoint paths (e.g. /open-api/core) were confirmed via the vendor's GitHub source rather than a docs page. The official MCP server's exact public URL/doc page wasn't found on docs.twenty.com (only confirmed via the pricing page FAQ and GitHub PRs); mcp_url is inferred from the Cloud API base URL pattern.
